purpose_statement: start lawful customer order intent by choosing a store or category path without leaving app-client
entry_rule: enter when customer has no active order and no direct detail context
exit_rule: exit to category_or_store_detail or cart_review

purpose_statement: convert discovery intent into a concrete purchasable selection context before cart review
entry_rule: enter from discovery selection or direct store or category re-entry
exit_rule: exit to cart_review

purpose_statement: review and adjust cart contents before entering checkout gating
entry_rule: enter from category_or_store_detail or resumed cart context
exit_rule: exit to checkout_confirm or stay local for edits

purpose_statement: validate order intent and commit submission only when checkout rules pass
entry_rule: enter only from cart_review with a valid draft order intent
exit_rule: exit to active_order_tracking after submit or stay local on block

purpose_statement: keep customer visibility on the active or terminal order without exposing partner or captain control actions
entry_rule: enter from order_submit_or_completion or direct returning-user tracking re-entry
exit_rule: exit when the order is completed or cancelled and the customer leaves the flow

purpose_statement: capture a proxy exception request on the customer surface without exposing internal ops governance
entry_rule: enter only when customer must use the proxy exception branch
exit_rule: exit to proxy_request_tracking or leave the exception flow

purpose_statement: reflect proxy review status back to the customer after internal governance acts on the case
entry_rule: enter from proxy_request_entry or returning-user proxy re-entry
exit_rule: exit when the proxy case reaches a terminal decision

purpose_statement: provide the partner lawful entry board for active DSH order handling
entry_rule: enter when partner receives or resumes pending store-side work
exit_rule: exit to partner_order_workspace

purpose_statement: advance one partner-owned order through accept prepare ready handoff or local rejection inside a single workspace
entry_rule: enter from partner_orders_board or return from store maintenance repair
exit_rule: exit to captain path handoff or internal issue handling

purpose_statement: repair store readiness inventory hours zones or service modes so the main partner path can continue
entry_rule: enter only when partner handling detects a store-side blocker
exit_rule: exit back to partner_order_workspace or orders_board

purpose_statement: expose partner-only exception cases that require internal handling without redefining the mainline partner journey
entry_rule: enter only from partner_order_workspace when an exception queue is needed
exit_rule: exit back to partner_order_workspace after issue review

purpose_statement: present available delivery work and let the captain lawfully claim the next job
entry_rule: enter when captain has available DSH offers or resumes the assignment stage
exit_rule: exit to captain_execution_workspace

purpose_statement: keep all captain execution work in one surface from acceptance through in-delivery progress
entry_rule: enter from offers_list after acceptance or from resumed in-delivery work
exit_rule: exit to proof_capture or terminal resolution

purpose_statement: record or verify delivery proof when completion policy requires an explicit gate
entry_rule: enter only when delivery execution reaches a proof-required completion gate
exit_rule: exit to customer tracking or flow exit

purpose_statement: handle optional field activation or visit support without turning app-field into a default DSH route tree
entry_rule: enter only when field participation is enabled and requested
exit_rule: exit after activation work completes or the branch is skipped

purpose_statement: provide the single internal entry board for DSH operational oversight and escalation routing
entry_rule: enter when ops needs DSH governance visibility or escalation handling
exit_rule: exit to exception workspace or proxy governance list

purpose_statement: resolve specific partner or captain exceptions without turning control-panel into an execution mirror
entry_rule: enter only from ops_orders_board for an identified exception case
exit_rule: exit to ops_orders_board or a closed resolution state

purpose_statement: adjust peak-mode governance when operational pressure requires an internal control change
entry_rule: enter from ops_orders_board when peak-mode review is required
exit_rule: exit back to ops_orders_board after save or no-op review

purpose_statement: list proxy exception cases awaiting internal review without mixing them into the main ops board detail flow
entry_rule: enter from control-panel entry or an ops redirection into proxy governance
exit_rule: exit to proxy_request_review_workspace

purpose_statement: review estimate offer approval and scheduling decisions for a proxy case inside one internal workspace
entry_rule: enter from proxy_requests_list for a selected proxy case
exit_rule: exit back to proxy_requests_list or closed review state
